title.zh: 保健品（供应医疗器械——豁免）命令 2022
title.en: Health Products (Supply of Medical Devices — Exemption) Order 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Health Products (Supply of Medical Devices — Exemption) Order 2022 and comes into operation on 1 September 2022.

heading.en: Exemption in relation to supply by retail

text.en: 3. The Health Products (Import, Wholesale and Supply of Medical Devices — Exemption) Order 2020 (G.N. No. S 78/2020) is revoked.
